youtube_title: The Thanksgiving Lineup Just Dropped (Zoom In) | Funny Family Cartoon
description:
Aunt Bev made a big poster for Thanksgiving, like a music festival. The headliner is the sweet potato casserole.
Then Marcus zooms in on the small print.

#cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #thanksgiving
tiktok_caption: always read the small print on the family poster. #cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #thanksgiving

lines.text: Family, gather round. The lineup just dropped.
What lineup? It is November. We have a turkey, not a festival.
This year Thanksgiving is a festival. I made a poster. It has a font.
It is on me. I am the phone. Everyone is looking at me, as usual.
Okay. Headliner, giant letters. Grandma's sweet potato casserole. Live.
With the marshmallows. On the main stage. That is the dining table.
Second line. The green bean thing. With the crunchy onions on top.
The crunchy onions are touring separately this year. They have their own fans.
Girl, zoom in.
Why would I zoom in on a poster about beans?
Because the small print is where the family keeps the truth.
Fine. Zooming. Doors open at noon. Turkey goes on at four.
Set times subject to the turkey. The turkey does not care about your schedule.
Last year the turkey went on at nine. We ate cereal and waited like fans.
Main stage is the dining table. Second stage, the kids' table.
The kids' table is a side stage. It has a great crowd. Very honest.
I am thirty one. Why am I on the kids' table stage?
You are a crowd favorite with the five year olds. You do the spoon on your nose.
One time. I did that one time.
There is video. I have it. I bring it up every year.
Wait. Small letters. Reunion tour. Uncle Ron.
That's right. I'm back.
Uncle Ron was not invited for three years. Because of the gravy.
The gravy was an accident. The gravy boat had a loose handle and a lot of confidence.
The ceiling is clean now. We painted. Everybody gets a second chance.
This time I am doing an acoustic set. No gravy. Just me and a spoon.
He will be on the side stage. With Marcus. And the spoon.
What about tickets? Who even gets in?
General admission. Bring a dish. VIP is a paper towel with your name on it.
I have been VIP once. I was very moved. I used it on the gravy.
There is a merch table?
Aprons. Twelve dollars. They say I survived the turkey.
Nobody survives the turkey. It survives us. It sits in the fridge until December.
Zoom in more.
Weather. Hot, ninety degrees, near the oven only.
Stay hydrated. Hug the cranberry sauce. It is cold. It comes out of the can still shaped like a can.
Lost and found. Uncle Ron's reading glasses. Found in the stuffing, two thousand nineteen.
I want them back. They were good glasses. They saw a lot.
Zoom in. Bottom left. Tiny, tiny letters.
Special guest. Marcus's girlfriend.
Aunt Bev. I do not have a girlfriend.
I booked her anyway. It brings in a crowd. Grandma bought a new blouse.
It's called marketing, Marcus.
There is one more line. It is the smallest one. I needed two fingers.
Venue.
Marcus's apartment.
My kitchen is getting new floors. Your place has a great sound. And an oven.
My apartment has four chairs and one pan!
Four chairs is a standing room show. Very exclusive.
Twenty six confirmed. Two maybes. One dog. The dog is the maybe.
When did you even book my apartment?
In August. You said sure. You were asleep on the side stage.
I recorded that too. He said, sure, Aunt Bev, whatever you want. Very clear.
Okay. Fine. But I am not on the side stage in my own apartment.
Of course not, baby. In your apartment, you are the headliner.
Really?
Zoom in. Headliner. Marcus. Dishes. All night.
That's the longest set on the poster. Respect.
Can I at least get a VIP paper towel?
Baby. You are drying with all of them.
